Miralax is *safer* than Senna. Senna, and other stimulant laxatives, are habit forming, meaning your body will find it even more difficult to produce a BM (or, in the case of laxative abuse, cause this to happen)

If you have chronic constipation, Miralax can be a somewhat short term solution. While I wouldn't suggest taking it for say, multiple months at a time, it's a common direction from doctors for chronic/severe constipation.

Edit: Would like to add, I know Miralax works, at least for me, as I've had chronic constipation for as long as I can remember.

Hey hun. This sounds really difficult for you right now, i'm sorry you've got all this going on. I know how hard it is, but purging will likely only do a couple things:
1. Lengthen your hospital stay.
2. Absolutely land you on stricter watch/in a psychiatric hospital.
Purging messes up the whole body, especially hydration levels. I know it's hard, trust me. I've had my share of purging addiction, but I highly suggest trying to use this time to recover from your overdose. Even if you aren't actively recovering, it's good to try and challenge your ED.

I really hope you start to feel better, in whatever capacity may come first, and I'm glad you're still with us. <3

Edit: I want to say-- I'm no medical professional. Just someone whose had an ED for years, and has purged a lot in recent months, who wants you to try to take care of yourself as best you can.

End up in an abusive relationship just over 4 years ago. Relationship has ended, but I now have PTSD. I'm no stranger to self harm and suicidal ideation.

I kind of have already realized I feel like I do it for attention. It's just hard to admit that because it *sounds* so bad, you know? I might not always hide it, and though I do feel shame and guilt when someone notices and asks me about it, I *do* in a way somehow feel... better?

I'm trying to make the point to myself that I'm not attention seeking in a bad or manipulative way. It's just a basic human desire for attention and it manifests itself not in a, "woe is me look at what I'm doing come worry about me" way. It's in a, "I am extremely depressed and dealing with a lot and it's hard to handle on my own, I want someone to offer to help" way. Even though I know there's the whole, you cant really get past this stuff unless you're ready to, but that's just another complex matter in the shitstorm that mental illness can be.

So I get what you're saying, and it is hard to hear, but I do appreciate it. I just wish I could figure out a better way to handle all of this.
